name: causoryn-dev
description: Local development marketplace for the Causoryn ZCode plugin. Add this directory (integrations/zcode) via Settings -> Plugin Management -> Discover -> the + button as a local directory, then install causoryn from the list. Development and testing only; the plugin launches the compiled monorepo bundle (packages/mcp-server/dist/mcp-server.mjs, TŞ v2.1 §17.1).

plugins.name: causoryn
plugins.description: Deterministic, local, LLM-free code analysis for ZCode: read-only workspace graphs, architecture mapping, symbol search and evidence provenance over a stdio MCP server.
